steps.label: 6 operations
steps.text:
• Add a visit for an owner's pet
    POST /api/owners/{ownerId}/pets/{petId}/visits
• Get an owner by ID
    GET /api/owners/{ownerId}
• List owners
    GET /api/owners
• getPet
    GET /api/pets/{petId}
• listVets
    GET /api/vets
• listVisits
    GET /api/visits
